I have poor network stability in my house. Are there some ways to improve the work of the router?
What are some ways to improve my home WiFi network?

First: what are your walls made of? If they're plaster or stucco, then you have a problem and should probably go with a wired network.

Otherwise: put your router in the highest central location in your house, and orient the antennae outward 45° from vertical so that people directly under the router will still be connected (due to how omnidirectional antennae work).

Change the transmission channel on your router to a clear channel. Ideally, there shouldn't be a network within 2 channels of yours in either direction, but that may be hard to with how common wifi is.

If your router doesn't have external antennae, get a new one with removable external antennae, then replace the antennae with high-gain antennae.
